dedupe_keys.name: birds 1u cubesat on orbit electrical power telemetry

description: The BIRDS telemetry deposit records electrical-power measurements from four 1U CubeSats based on Kyushu Institute of Technology’s standardized bus. Excel workbooks correspond to NEPALISAT, RAAVANA, TSURU and UGUISU. The metadata identify battery and five-sided solar-panel voltage, current and temperature, sampled at ninety seconds in normal operation or ten seconds in fast mode. Coverage is low Earth orbit, with completed mission records for three satellites and an initially continuing TSURU record. Public Mendeley access is free under CC BY 4.0. Panel failures appear in two missions, but ground-station downloads and differing mission spans limit interpretation as an uninterrupted common time series. The review did not verify continued updates after deposit publication. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating satellite power-budget or fault-detection simulations. data-aalto-1-radmon-radiation-monitor supplies complementary space-environment observations, without a verified temporal or orbital match. No telemetry files were fetched.
